title: Забота о маме Лёвы  (Caring for Lyova's Mother)

segments.t: In the storage room, Kostya and Nastya nearly get caught again and pretend the rustling noise was just the kitchen cat. Moments later, Chef Barinov corners Lyova and guilts his sous-chef for never taking his devoted mother out to cultural events.
Нам с тобой нужно серьезно поговорить.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Wait a second, are you sure that...' Because a second are Kostya sure, Barinov treats the matter as settled. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'Well, of course.' Over the truth and the situation, Kostya answers Barinov without a second thought.
'Come on, do not be afraid.' By coming on do not be afraid, Lyova keeps his side of the story grounded. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'I am not afraid at all.' Even though he is not afraid at all, Barinov keeps a steady face in front of Kostya.
'Who is in there?' Here asking who in there is shows Kostya looking for the real truth.
'Just our kitchen cat.' Around the truth and situation, Lyova sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov.
'Otherwise he will spot us.' Realizing that otherwise he will spot them changes how Barinov handles the situation.
Нам с тобой нужно серьезно поговорить.
'You and I need to have a serious talk.' Noting that Barinov and he needs to have a serious talk keeps Kostya's side of the story simple and clear.
'How could you, Lyova?' Here wondering how Barinov could shows Lyova looking for the real truth. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'Why do you neglect your own mother like that?' By asking why Kostya neglect Kostya's own mother like, Barinov presses Kostya for a straight answer.
'What do you mean?' By wondering what Barinov means, Kostya presses Barinov for a straight answer.

'Are you not ashamed of yourself, Lyova?' Asking whether Barinov not ashamed of themselves is how Lyova puts Barinov on the spot. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'Well, I will take her out sometime.' Adding that he will take her out sometime fills in the missing piece for Kostya. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Нам с тобой нужно серьезно поговорить.

That wraps up this scene as while Kostya and Nastya hide in the storage room and blame the noise on the kitchen cat, Chef Barinov guilts Lyova into taking his mother out for the evening. See you next time!
